name: punchy_modern_rock
description: Punchier variant of modern_rock — emphasised kick body, controlled boxy 350 Hz region, forward snare/vocal presence at 3 kHz, gentle cymbal control. Calibrated to a real session iteration (v11 manual fine-tune over the modern_rock baseline).
sources: Calibrated against a real-session master that received the following manual fine-tune over the modern_rock baseline
Recommended master chain (copy into mix_config.master): see master_chain_template below
calibration_note: Tonal balance targets are wideband band-RMS at the integrated_target LUFS (-14). Spectrum is close to modern_rock but with: less air, scooped lower-mid (around 350 Hz region cleaner), kept presence at 3 kHz region.

master_chain_template.note: Paste this `master` block into mix_config.json for the v11-style punchy master chain. Bus saturation drive on drums = 0.4 (slightly heavier than the default 0.3).
